name: Bloxy Bingo
desc:
Welcome to Bingo, a game where you can play Bingo with friends and others!

We have plenty of Bingo to play:
🇬🇧 British Bingo (90 Ball)
🇺🇸 American Bingo (75 Ball)
🇲🇽 Lotería (54 Picture Ball)
🕹️ Arcade Bingo (80 Ball)


Show your style with custom markers, mascots & themes, then celebrate victories with custom calls, dances & tracks! 
Private servers are available for parties – they allow for control of game selection, speed & caller - but have reduced gem rewards when few play.

❓ FAQ: https://devforum.roblox.com/t/bb/872274
📜 Game Manual: https://devforum.roblox.com/t/bb/860980
